cases.reviewQuestion: Does the Q2 issuer-reported construction-progress observation remain narrowly supported after separating early construction, May furnace commissioning, and later partially operating furnace lines?

leads.finding: The October 2025 local coverage says actual expansion work began in May, while officials celebrated at a September ceremony.
leads.limitation: The October 2 publication and late-September ceremony are not May's exact construction start date.

leads.finding: USAC states commissioning of the new smelter began in May by firing the first new furnace; other lines were forecast, not yet evidenced all running.
leads.limitation: Announcement is retrospective, issuer-authored; cannot infer precise first-operation day or all nine were commissioned.

leads.publisher: United States Antimony Corporation / SEC EDGAR
leads.finding: Note 9 describes expansion substantially completed and approximately $4.1 million of related assets in service in late Q2; Note 16 still has substantial construction-in-progress.
leads.limitation: Accounting period is not exact physical completion day; not plant-wide commissioning or the sum of separate government finance.

leads.finding: Reporter describes active processing inside the new nine-furnace building, with seven new furnaces operational but not all simultaneously.
leads.limitation: Neither reporter site-visit day nor sustained throughput nor all nine simultaneous operation was independently established.

checksBeforeDecision: Verify original 10-Q Note 9 and Note 16 in full, reconciling gross CIP and limited PP&E-in-service.
Separate initial construction in May 2025 from ceremonial groundbreaking in September 2025.
Separate May 2026 commissioning report from August 27 partial-operation reporting and exact event days.
Do not attribute $39M corporate capex, $27M parent, $20M Montana allocation, $7M Alaska allocation, or $12.8M April receipt as separate government investments.
If citing the Ledger independently, separately register a source through authorized curation; do not substitute it for canonical SEC M3 evidence.

cases.reviewQuestion: Does the NRCan March 2026 funded Extended Operations status concern only CMRDD work at the Hub100 demonstration facility, without projecting a separate commercial Centre of Excellence onto that award?

leads.finding: Recipient announces opening Kingston Hub100 REEPure demonstration plant, with 100 tonnes magnetic-material annual DESIGN capacity and rare earth oxide/nickel-cobalt product capability.
leads.limitation: An opening announcement does not prove full actual throughput, start of the later funded Extended Operations, or commercial Hub500 operation.

leads.finding: Agreement CMRDD2-048 funds Kingston Demonstration Plant Extended Operations for CAD 4,893,125 over the registered contractual term.
leads.limitation: End of legal agreement on March 31 cannot be substituted for dated physical completion or paid disbursement.

leads.finding: Recipient describes a distinct future Kingston Centre of Excellence/commercial Hub, with 500 tonnes per year DESIGN capacity and a Q1 2026 start target.
leads.limitation: Planned 500-tonne capacity and operation target are not an achieved commissioning event and cannot change CMRDD project/award identity.

leads.finding: Current NRCan programme page lists the particular Kingston Demonstration Plant Extended Operations funded activity as completed in March 2026.
leads.limitation: Undated in-place page update does not prove status first became public in March, exact day or whole commercial Hub operation.

checksBeforeDecision: Read full NRCan programme record and agreement CMRDD2-048; preserve March 2026 as a month only.
Distinguish 2024 original Hub100 demonstration opening from the 2024–2026 funded Extended Operations programme.
Identify separately registered Kingston Centre of Excellence project before assessing 2025 CoE investment or Q1 2026 target.
Do not convert a 100-tonne or 500-tonne design capacity into measured output or conflate CMRDD with other federal or private funding.
Verify available source-body versions and exact human review at current M3 digest before any editorial adjudication.
